### You're looking for volunteering and free courses in sustainability near you! 

I've searched online and found some fantastic opportunities for you to explore.

**1. Young Feminist AI School 2026**

[Young Feminist AI School 2026](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/07/16/ai-for-gender-equality-un-women-ai-school-opens-for-changemakers/) is a free, practical AI training program that focuses on gender equality. You'll have hands-on experience with AI tools and receive mentorship throughout the program.

*   Get involved:
    *   Apply for the Young Feminist AI School 2026 through their website
    *   Participate in online discussions and forums related to the program
    *   Share your experiences and insights on social media using designated hashtags
*   To reach out: Email [info@opportunitiesforyouth.org](mailto:info@opportunitiesforyouth.org) with your interest in applying for the program.

**2. FutureLearn - Free Sustainability and Climate Change Online Courses**

[FutureLearn](https://www.futurelearn.com/courses/collections/reducing-your-environmental-impact) offers a range of free online courses on sustainability and climate change. You can learn new skills, pursue your interests, or advance your career with their short courses.

*   Get involved:
    *   Browse the course catalog and choose a course that aligns with your goals
    *   Register for the course through FutureLearn's website
    *   Participate in online discussions and forums related to the course
*   To reach out: Visit [www.futurelearn.com](http://www.futurelearn.com) and register for the courses that interest you.

**3. Free Online Environmental Sustainability Training Course**

[Free Courses in England](https://freecoursesinengland.co.uk/environmental-sustainability-course/) offers a free online environmental sustainability training course. You'll gain an overview of sustainable development, communities, energy management, and social responsibility in businesses.

*   Get involved:
    *   Access the course through FreecoursesinEngland's website
    *   Complete the course and obtain a certificate upon completion
    *   Share your experiences and insights on social media using designated hashtags
*   To reach out: Visit [www.freecoursesinengland.co.uk](http://www.freecoursesinengland.co.uk) to access the course.

**4. Coursera - Sustainability Courses & Certificates**

[Coursera](https://www.coursera.org/courses?query=sustainability) offers a range of sustainability courses and certificates. You can start learning sustainability on Coursera for free through two ways: auditing or taking a MOOC (Massive Open Online Course).

*   Get involved:

    *   Register for the course through Coursera's website
    *   Participate in online discussions and forums related to the course
